clauses.why: Durable, re-openable import activity for lost responses is a recovery subsystem beyond uploading a CSV to create users.
An operator admission switch is a deployment feature flag the request never asks for.
Enabling admission only exists because the spec introduced an operator admission switch.
Rollback procedure guarantees concern release management introduced by the spec, not bulk creation itself.
Attempt references exist only for the spec's asynchronous activity and recovery feature.
A Pending/Succeeded/Failed state model arises from the spec's queued-attempt design, not the request.
Access rules for an import activity history only matter because the spec added that history.
Seven-day result retention governs an activity log the request does not call for.
An operator-visible Pending count serves the spec's maintenance drain procedure, not bulk creation.
Binding queued attempts to received bytes only arises from the spec's asynchronous processing model.
Binding queued attempts to a directory after admission only arises from the spec's asynchronous model.
Re-checking authority at deferred commit only matters for the spec's queued work.
Idempotent delivery tracking by reference is extra machinery; existing-account conflicts already prevent duplicate users.
Distinguishing new attempts from replays only matters for the spec's reference and activity system.
Re-evaluating rules at delayed commit arises only from the spec's queued processing model.
Admission-disable semantics belong to the operator switch the spec introduced.
A five-minute completion deadline for queued attempts arises only from the spec's asynchronous design.
Immutable recorded outcomes belong to the spec's added activity history.
A recorded result surviving a lost response belongs to the spec's added recovery history.
Terminal-failure classification before a deadline belongs to the spec's queued-attempt model.
Cancellation of Pending attempts is only a question because the spec made imports asynchronous.
Persisting the admission switch across restarts serves an operator flag the request never asked for.
Restart-durable attempt records and deadlines belong to the spec's queued-attempt system.
Post-connection retrieval of admitted work serves the spec's asynchronous recovery feature.
A production-readiness gate on the admission switch is operational process beyond the request.
Gating admission on a provisioning precheck adds operator process tied to the spec's admission switch.
Adding an import does not remove single-user creation; this constrains nothing a builder would otherwise do.
Toggling admission only exists because the spec introduced the operator switch.
Hiding accounts of Pending attempts arises only from the spec's asynchronous attempt model.
Replay-suppression of invitations belongs to the spec's delivery-replay machinery.
Redacting filenames and emails from activity and operator views governs surfaces the request never asks for.
Importer retention inspection rules are a data-governance duty beyond the request's purpose.
Uniform refusal for reference lookups protects the spec's added reference system.
Recovery access during maintenance combines two features, activity and admission switch, both beyond the request.
Activity entry contents describe a history view the request does not call for.
Admission-versus-activity sequencing belongs to the spec's queued-attempt and reference system.
A 15-minute submission-reference window belongs to the spec's reference and replay machinery.
Replay-with-different-bytes rules belong to the spec's reference machinery.
Scoping references to admin and directory protects the spec's added reference system.
Expired-reference replay refusal belongs to the spec's reference and retention machinery.
Restates that ordinary creation rules govern identity availability, already said by C-44; decides nothing new.
Shipping with admission disabled serves the operator switch the request never asked for.
Sign-out effects on Pending work arise only from the spec's asynchronous attempts.
A rollback drain point is release-management procedure beyond bulk user creation.
Operator-only control of admission protects a switch the request never asked for.
Read-failure reporting for import activity governs a history view beyond the request.
Retention rules for refused uploads add a data-governance duty beyond the request.
Acknowledgements carrying attempt references belong to the spec's activity system.
Retention lifetime across rollback and redeploy is release management for the spec's activity history.
Durable-intake failure and same-reference retry semantics belong to the spec's admission machinery.
Drain-status availability serves the spec's operator rollback procedure, not the request.
